newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed weaker at 2.45 pct from parity rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed weaker at 2.45 pct from parity rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland (NBP) fixed the zloty at 3.1310 to the dollar, up from 3.1395 on Friday and at 1.8365 to the mark, down from 1.8280, the central bank said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 2.45 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, weaker than Friday's 2.50 percent fix.
The zloty was fixed at 2.47 percent from the floating parity rate, which changes in line with currency moves on world markets, against a 2.51 percent fix on Friday.
